title: pics or it didn't happen
tagline: was there a UFO sighting? did someone see the loch ness? we are curating the lens graph towards curating interesting experiences around the world.
description:
was there a UFO sighting? did someone see the loch ness? we are curating the lens graph towards curating interesting experiences around the world.

lens posts allow geo-tagging in order to identify where things are happening. references allow different options in order to boost/deflate different posts depending on sentiment.
how_its_made:
we use lens protocol for the social graph, the polygon PoS, ipfs, hardhat, ethers.js. 

there is a lot more we want to do integrating voting via semaphore and reputation from sismo or equivalent.

the main dilemma in designing this is how to geo-tag events while also allowing adequate privacy/anonymity to those who seek it.
